column1: # Havok reflection extracted from DarkSoulsRemastered.exe (hk_2015.1.0-r1, 64-bit, DSR).
# CLASS  : name <TAB> size <TAB> parent   (parent empty = root or unregistered base)
# MEMBER : class <TAB> name <TAB> offset <TAB> type <TAB> subtype <TAB> cArraySize <TAB> flags
# Source: hkReflect type records in the binary; member types translated to the hk2010 hkClassMember::Type enum.
# flags is always 0x0: hk2015 field flags have no hk2010 equivalent. Runtime-only pointers whose pointee is not
# reflected (hkReflect::Detail::Opaque) are emitted as type 20, subtype 0.
